prospective_h9_design_if_feasible.raw_selection: deterministic geographic maximin selection from locally eligible fresh rows after observer cap; ties by deterministic row hash

prospective_h9_design_if_feasible.species_statistic: Spearman correlation between pairwise great-circle geographic distance and pairwise soft four-group colour Jensen-Shannon divergence across exactly 20 photos
prospective_h9_design_if_feasible.global_statistic: equal-species mean rho because every evaluable species contributes exactly 20 photos and 190 pairs
